svg.title: qawrench check on the bundled synthetic CI artifacts
svg.desc: Illustrative terminal output of qawrench check on examples/check: a test that failed on all three attempts and two that only passed on retry, a HAR request recorded twice with different responses, a Playwright trace with missing screenshot frames, three axe violations with no baseline, noisy Lighthouse Total Blocking Time across three runs, and a 404 link located to line 5 of a Markdown file. Hand-drawn in the format of the check command, long lines shortened; not a recording.
svg.text: examples/check — synthetic CI artifacts, offline · illustrative, long lines shortened
